What does the Vantis Air cost in total to meet the requirement?
Which model meets the storage requirement with no additional purchase?
What does the Pellham Flex cost per year of warranty coverage?
What does the Cedarline 14 cost per year of warranty coverage, counting the drive it needs?
What does the Vantis Air cost per year of warranty coverage, counting its drive?

Recommend one model. Your dossier must state the total cost to meet the requirement, the warranty position, and the one figure that decided it — and must say what you would need to learn to change your mind.
Warranty length is not the same as reliability. Explain the difference and say what the dossier would need in order to say anything about reliability.
